title: Control API status
description: I0: what the control API's GET /status returns: the install's newest generation, why the newest manifest or secrets were refused if they were, and each world's state. A world's state is its runtime's own report (B1), or unknown when the runtime has not reported for three of its reporting intervals.

refused.description: Why the newest manifest or secrets were refused. The generation above keeps running.

worlds.description: Each world of the install, keyed by its save name.

published.description: The generation this world's runtime has been handed. Absent until vhd apply has created the world.

pending.description: A newer generation this world waits for.

waits_for.description: vhd apply: the change is to the world's container. an empty world: it restarts the game while players may be online, and vhd apply --disconnect-players applies it now.

state.description: The runtime's state as it last reported it, or unknown when it has not reported recently.

report.description: The runtime's last report, as contracts/game-runtime.status.schema.json defines it. The control plane validated it on arrival.
